comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body:
So why is the ground mud and patches standalone meshes stacked ontop of each other? 

That is what's causing your weird visual flickers on the ground. 

It just seems rushed with minimal iteration. 

Plan the game before hand 
Make a Readme document 

Start planning the phase map for v.01 
Let ai set up its own order of tasks and completion milestones 
Each time you itterate and review changes 

-document all the clear issues while ai finishes the phase plan 

Before planning 
V0.2 phases. You let ai first clean up all the issues from the stand alone document 

Then you let it make the v0.1 unit tests 

After it passes your personal quality checks 
You Start molding your v0.2 phase map

And you just repeat this exact same process all the way until your reach v1
